name: team_planning_move_place
description: Move one of a person's places in a scenario of a Team Planning plan to another unit, or to Unassigned, keeping their other places. from_unit_id names the place: a unit, with from_position_id for a place in a position, or 'unassigned' for a person in no live unit. to_unit_id is the unit they move to, or 'unassigned' to drop the place. allocation (above 0, at most 1) and role describe the new place; a place they already hold in that unit is replaced. Written as one AssignmentSet. Refused on the baseline, and unless the caller is one of the plan's editors.

scenario_id.description: A scenario of the plan. Not the baseline.

from_unit_id.description: The unit the place is in, or 'unassigned'.

from_position_id.description: The position the place is in, when it is in one.

to_unit_id.description: The unit to move to, or 'unassigned'.

allocation.description: The new place's allocation. Required unless moving to 'unassigned'.

role.description: The person's role in the new place, such as Lead.
